problems.quote: the Supreme Court's State of Rajasthan v. Union of India (1977)
problems.problem: The case State of Rajasthan v. Union of India (1977) concerns Article 356 (President's Rule), not the public trust doctrine. The public trust doctrine in India was articulated in environmental cases like M.C. Mehta v. Kamal Nath (1997).
problems.correction: the Supreme Court's M.C. Mehta v. Kamal Nath (1997)
problems.verifierReason: State of Rajasthan v. Union of India (1977) deals with Art.356; public trust doctrine from M.C. Mehta v. Kamal Nath (1997).
